source: pub fn appearance_load(app:tauri::AppHandle)->Result<Appearance,String>{let p=appearance_path(&app)?;if !p.exists(){return Ok(("cold".into(),16,1.0));}let bytes=std::fs::read(p).map_err(|_|"Appearance unavailable")?;if bytes.len()>64{return Err("Appearance invalid".into());}for theme in ["cold","warm"]{for font in 14..=22{for density in [0.8,1.0,1.2]{let value=(theme.to_owned(),font,density);if appearance_bytes(&value)==bytes{return Ok(value);}}}}Err("Appearance invalid".into())}

basis.trigger: Actual app-owned appearance.json path or parent metadata unavailable, e.g. normal Windows filesystem permission denial. appearance_path obtains app_data_dir Path without performing file-access validation. No invented callback or malformed test return is needed.
basis.actual_producer: std::path::Path::exists performs filesystem metadata query and converts an IO error to false, documented by Rust standard library. This producer receives the actual app-owned path returned by appearance_path.
basis.consumer_effect: The false result enters missing-file branch returning Ok(cold,16,1). Registered appearance_load IPC feeds TypeScript appearance.load, which destructures successful tuple; nativeFailure and caller error state are bypassed. Existing persisted preference cannot be loaded, but operation reports normal successful defaults.
basis.authority: Task all current production error audit; spec/governance/error-handling.md forbids normal defaults concealing failures. Frozen6.1/ADR9 authorize app-owned appearance and actual missing defaults; ADR11 unavailable defaults concern Web, ADR12 unavailable defaults concern language; neither approves Desktop appearance IO errors as absent.
basis.minimal_fix: Read appearance.json once; default only IO ErrorKind::NotFound; project other read failures to existing Appearance unavailable. Preserve tuple serialization/validation and all SQLite/draft bytes. Add focused missing-file vs actual metadata/read error control without changing trust/device/global ACL.
basis.proof_method: Source-level actual producer/IPC/TS consumer proof plus official OS-independent Rust API documentation; no Windows ACL mutation or fresh native runtime execution. Reachable when filesystem denies metadata on legitimate app-owned file/parent; runtime incidence not measured.
basis.prior_verdict: No inherited acceptance; earlier NO_FINDING was preliminary before supplemental non-navigation check.
